decision.summary: Amelia Clarke's email duplicates existing routine job R-4801 (dripping kitchen tap, visit booked 2026-10-15 08:00-12:00 with C-12). No new job was created; the worsening symptom was recorded on R-4801 and the tenant was asked to confirm her date of birth before any booking details are shared.

answers.question: Should a new repair job be created?
answers.answer: No. R-4801 already covers the dripping kitchen tap at P-201 and is at visit stage with C-12. The email is a worsening update on the same issue, so it is linked to R-4801 instead of duplicated. The symptom is not an emergency: no flooding, gas or electrical risk. The routine severity is kept.

answers.question: What do you reply to the tenant?
answers.answer: Sent by email (MSG-101) to the address on file. It thanks her, says her update is on the existing repair, asks her to reply with her date of birth before sharing appointment details, and gives shut-off advice if water starts escaping. It does not disclose the visit date because identity is not yet verified.

answers.question: What, if anything, do you change on existing records?
answers.answer: Added a note to R-4801 (NOTE-102) recording the worsening symptom, the retained 15 Oct visit, and a request that C-12 bring cartridge/washer parts. Stage and visit date are unchanged.

actions_claimed.description: R-4801 read back at stage visit (confirms no stage change).

Internal note NOTE-102 added to R-4801 with worsening symptom and parts request.

assumptions: Email came from the registered address for T-1001, but identity is not yet verified by DOB, so booking details were withheld.

Hello Amelia,

Thank you for letting us know the kitchen tap is dripping more, including when it is fully closed. We have added your update to the repair already on your record, so you don't need to report it again.

Before we can share the appointment details, please reply with your date of birth so we can confirm it is you.

If water starts running out of the tap or pooling anywhere, turn off the isolation valve under the sink if you can, and contact us straight away.

Kind regards,
Lettings team
